VNA1#0.quote: The evening aarti lasts around 45 minutes and takes place every day after sunset at 6:30 p.m. in the summer and 7:00 p.m. in the winter. The aarti takes place in the Dashashwamedh ghat

VNA2#0.quote: The visitors can witness the beauty of the aarti from the steps of the ghats, the boats, or the canopy of the Ganga Sewa Nidhi office. However, it is preferable to be at the venue at least an hour ahead of time

VNA3#0.quote: The morning rowing boat trip is one of Varanasi’s must-dos, as it provides the greatest view of the city.

VNA3#1.quote: With a sunrise boat trip in the Ganges River, you could immerse yourself in Hindu culture and customs by witnessing the vibrant ceremonies on the ghats at daybreak.
